status: Original instructor-authored task specifications for a proposed pilot; not used to claim learning outcomes
common_rules: Python 3.10+, standard library, no external data. Each task gets 15 minutes after a difficulty pilot. During transfer, no AI or prior solution access. Return a value without printing. Use only inputs described below.

tasks.name: Qualifying sales
tasks.specification: Given a list of numeric sales and a numeric threshold, return the sum of values greater than or equal to threshold. An empty list returns 0. Negative values are valid.

tasks.name: Safe average
tasks.specification: Return the arithmetic mean of a list of numbers. Return None when the list is empty. Do not treat zero as missing.

tasks.name: Temperature window
tasks.specification: Return values between low and high, inclusive, preserving order and duplicates. Assume low <= high.

tasks.name: Book category counts
tasks.specification: Return a dictionary counting each exact category string. An empty list returns an empty dictionary. Matching is case-sensitive.

tasks.name: Approved attendance minutes
tasks.specification: Each record is a pair (minutes, approved). Return the sum of minutes for approved records whose minutes >= minimum. Boolean approved is supplied explicitly. An empty list returns 0.

tasks.name: First qualifying sensor
tasks.specification: Return the zero-based index of the first value >= threshold, or None when no value qualifies. Values may include zero and negatives.

scoring.planning_0_to_4: One point each: specific goal, decomposition, predicted example, verification strategy. Score before assistance.
scoring.transfer_0_to_100: Correctness 50, explanation 25, debugging justification 25. Explanations and reasoning are scored by blinded educators; automated tests only inform correctness.

calibration_note: The tasks are not established equivalent forms. Pilot and match difficulty, time and construct coverage before assigning conditions. Keep instructor solutions out of learner-facing materials.
